answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments tie each agent's stake to a succinct proof, while a verifiable delay function calibrated to basalt hardness forces sequential work that cannot be parallelized. The protocol requires a minimum 10 ETH stake and slashes 150% of the bond on any double-sign, giving attackers negative expected utility. Rational agents thus converge to a robust Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates, and the orchard of attestations emits a ripple of finality across consensus.
